tools.name: teamgantt_get_current_user
tools.description: Get the signed-in TeamGantt user: name, email, time zone, today's date and the companies (accounts) the user belongs to. Call this first to find company ids. TeamGantt API: GET /current_user.

tools.name: teamgantt_list_projects
tools.description: List the projects the user can see, pre-sorted starred first then by name. Default is Active projects, 100 per page. TeamGantt API: GET /projects.

tools.name: teamgantt_get_project
tools.description: Get one project: dates, status, chart days, permission, members (accesses) and teams. TeamGantt API: GET /projects/{project_id}.

tools.name: teamgantt_get_project_schedule
tools.description: Get the full schedule of a project: groups, subgroups and tasks (with dates, percent complete, assignments). Use is_flat_list for one flat array. TeamGantt API: GET /projects/{project_id}/children.

tools.name: teamgantt_list_groups
tools.description: List the groups and subgroups of one or more projects (useful to find a parent_group_id for a new task). TeamGantt API: GET /groups.

tools.name: teamgantt_list_tasks
tools.description: List tasks across projects, with filters: project, name search, date range, overdue, unassigned, resource. Active projects by default. To see one person's tasks for a day, pass user_resource_ids and the same start_date and end_date. TeamGantt API: GET /tasks.

tools.name: teamgantt_get_task
tools.description: Get one task or milestone: dates, days, percent complete, estimated hours, assigned resources, dependencies and comment counts. TeamGantt API: GET /tasks/{id}.

tools.name: teamgantt_list_comments
tools.description: List the comments and notes on a project, a group or a task. TeamGantt API: GET /{target}/{target_id}/comments.

tools.name: teamgantt_list_company_users
tools.description: List the users of a company (account): names, emails, roles. Needs account holder or manager access. TeamGantt API: GET /companies/{company_id}/users.

tools.name: teamgantt_list_resources
tools.description: List all resources of a company, split by type (company resources, project resources, users). Resources are the labels used to schedule tasks. TeamGantt API: GET /companies/{company_id}/resources/all.

tools.name: teamgantt_get_timesheets
tools.description: Get the signed-in user's timesheet: tasks with tracked and estimated hours per day in a date range. TeamGantt API: GET /timesheets.

tools.name: teamgantt_get_workload
tools.description: See how busy people or resources are: scheduled work grouped by day, week, month or year. TeamGantt API: GET /workload/{resource_type}.

tools.name: teamgantt_create_task
tools.description: WRITE: create a new task or milestone in a project. It changes the customer's schedule and is not repeated automatically. Without parent_group_id the task goes in the last group. TeamGantt API: POST /tasks.

tools.name: teamgantt_create_comment
tools.description: WRITE: add a comment or a note to a project, group or task. People who are @mentioned may get an email. It is not repeated automatically. TeamGantt API: POST /{target}/{target_id}/comments.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: teamgantt_get_current_user, teamgantt_get_task, teamgantt_list_comments, teamgantt_list_company_users, teamgantt_create_comment · Public sink: teamgantt_get_current_user, teamgantt_create_task, teamgantt_create_comment.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: teamgantt_get_current_user, teamgantt_get_task, teamgantt_list_comments, teamgantt_list_company_users, teamgantt_create_comment · Public sink: teamgantt_get_current_user, teamgantt_create_task, teamgantt_create_comment

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
